name: creative-mastery
description: One-shot videos generated by code: from a prompt to a finished MP4 with synthetic voice, procedural music, sound effects and word-by-word captions. HTML + GSAP + Canvas rendered locally with headless Chrome and ffmpeg — no API keys, no GPU. Includes styles (paper cut-out stop motion, kinetic editorial, dark launch, risograph, editorial collage…), motion and story craft, automatic QA and contact-sheet review.
